entities.summary: Ivan Stepanovych Marchuk is a contemporary Ukrainian painter, founder of the Pliontanism technique, Merited Artist of Ukraine, laureate of the Shevchenko National Prize, Honorary Academician of the National Academy of Arts of Ukraine, Honorary Citizen of Ternopil and Kyiv.
